notes.title: The latest entry in the "Bubble Bobble" series release in winter 2025!
notes.notes:
Explore again and again, grow stronger every time! The first-ever step-up Bubble Bobble!

Bub, the bubble-blowing dragon sets out on an adventure in a “sweet” dungeon that changes every time!



The game trailer is already out too:[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AsuoLXelpv8"][/dynamiclink]



For the latest news and more info on the game, please see the official site:

Bubble Bobble Sugar Dungeon：https://www.taito.co.jp/en/BBSD
